meta.description: Designs and implements Spring Data JPA repositories, projections, query patterns, custom repositories, CQRS read models, entity relationships, and persistence performance fixes for Java 25 and Spring Boot 4 projects. Use when the task needs repository-boundary decisions or concrete JPA implementation patterns from this skill. Do not use for generic SQL help or project-wide migration work that belongs in another skill.
